1479-3534-5700-5701-8345.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3534-5700-5701-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Field of the Dead trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2292-2459-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites:
You can pay for Rograkh's commander tax if applicable.
You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Rograkh is starting in your graveyard.
2292-2459-5006-8170.description:
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Rograkh spell. Then, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Rograkh, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

742-8266.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
742-8266.description:
Cast Demonic Consultation by paying {B}, naming a card not in your library and thus exiling your library.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using any creature. Fblthp triggers, causing you to win the game.

678-728-5865.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn
678-728-5865.description:
Cast Flamecache Gecko by paying its mana cost.
When Flamecache Gecko enters, it triggers, adding {B}{R}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Flamecache Gecko.
When Flamecache Gecko dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Flamecache Gecko from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Repeat.

539-3821-4247-4679-6821.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-3821-4247-4679-6821.description:
Cause Peregrine Drake to become an enchantment using Jump Scare.
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

654-1021-5412-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, giving it flying until end of turn.
Repeat.

803-1477-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
803-1477-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Repeat from step 3.

4881-5929-6909-8200.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-5929-6909-8200.description:
Cast Grub's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-4574-6972.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
728-4574-6972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Arcbound Reclaimer.
When Arcbound Reclaimer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Reclaimer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Reclaimer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an artifact card in your graveyard.
If needed, hold priority and repeat step 1 until Arcbound Reclaimer dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When Arcbound Reclaimer dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1.

586-728-864-3125-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-728-864-3125-5477.description:
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Insidious Roots.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-5478-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2
4094-5478-6753-7824-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

1497-5220-6900-7918.description:
Cast Wild Cantor by paying its mana cost.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another Goblin, Orc or Army you control

338-7855.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give The Great Goblin lifelink.
You have a way to gain life.
338-7855.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
The Great Goblin's first ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain 2 life due to its lifelink.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-5116-7714.description:
Cast Gilded Lotus by paying its mana cost.
When Gilded Lotus enters, Ultron triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Resolve the Ultron trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a copy of Gilded Lotus that is a 2/2 Robot Villain creature.
During your next turn, activate the Gilded Lotus token by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the Gilded Lotus token.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with five or more page counters on it

4067-7421.description:
Activate Diary of Dreams by tapping it, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Diary of Dreams.
Repeat.

628-2292-5007.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.
628-2292-5007.notes: The remaining -1/-1 counter can be removed each loop to gain infinite colored mana.

500-1181-2719-3191.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and creating two token copies of it that are nonlegendary copies of Kairi.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing one of the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces tokens.
When the token dies, it triggers. Choose either mode.
Resolve Sacrifice, adding six {B}.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger from step 5, causing you to mill six cards and return Saw in Half and Sacrifice from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat
500-1181-2719-3191.notes: You can forego casting Sacrifice if you have enough black mana. This'll allow you to net creature tokens. The additional Kairi trigger in step 4 can be used to put all instants and sorceries from your library and graveyard into your hand, or to bounce permanents.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1251-3259-7353.easyPrerequisites: Opponents have at least two creature cards in their graveyards.
1251-3259-7353.notablePrerequisites: Opponents with creature cards in their graveyards cannot block creatures you control.
1251-3259-7353.description:
Deal combat damage using Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached. Shark Shredder and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Shark Shredder trigger, putting a creature card from the defending player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1251-3259-7353.notes: If there happens to be two or more creatures with haste in opponents' graveyards, you can omit Dragonlord Kolaghan so long as both Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached do not have summoning sickness.

1394-2060-4565-5256-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Ozolith, the Shattered Spire.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Ozolith, the Shattered Spire.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

2068-4283-7220.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
Whisper does not have summoning sickness.
2068-4283-7220.description:
Activate Whisper by tapping it, sacrificing Glamermite and any other creature you control, targeting any other creature card in your graveyard.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Whisper's ability, targeting Glamermite.
Resolve the copy of Whisper's ability, returning Glamermite from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Glamermite enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Whisper.
Resolve the original Whisper ability, returning the targeted creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1462-2034-4679-7220.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Glamermite.
When the Glamermite token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Glamermite token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2281-5256-6909.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2281-5256-6909.description:
Cast Carnage by paying {2}{B}{R}. 
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Carnage.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Carnage.
When Carnage dies, Saffi triggers, returning Carnage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2146-4331-4993-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

560-4550-5231-5572.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-4550-5231-5572.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Dragon Appeasement triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

560-2511-4550-5572.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2511-4550-5572.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Dragon Appeasement triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities.
Repeat.

224-3147-3314-3430-5478.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using three in any combination of {W} and/or {U}, and have the mana to cast it.
224-3147-3314-3430-5478.description:
Cast the creature in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from your hand to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Chulane.
Resolve the creature spell cast in step 1.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning the creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-3967-6773.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
1636-3967-6773.description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
Repeat.

813-2104-3563.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Temporal Manipulation and Flicker of Fate.
813-2104-3563.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation and Flicker of Fate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2034-3097-3490-4446.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Cleric
You control an additional creature.
2034-3097-3490-4446.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

1003-2438-5220-5683.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Phyrexian Walker and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat.

141-5147-5748.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one historic permanent card in your graveyard.
141-5147-5748.description:
Cast What Must Be Done by paying {3}{W}{W}, targeting any historic permanent card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting What Must Be Done.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying What Must Be Done, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of What Must Be Done, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2703-2816-5149.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle and Power Artifact attached to Myr Propagator.
Myr Propagator does not have summoning sickness.
2034-2703-2816-5149.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr Propagator token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {1} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

3138-3717-4124.notablePrerequisites: Viridian Joiner does not have summoning sickness and has a power of five or greater.
3138-3717-4124.description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}, targeting Viridian Joiner.
Malachite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Viridian Joiner.
Repeat.
If Viridian Joiner has power six or greater, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may then target any other permanent using Malachite Talisman's ability.

2011-3920-4050.notablePrerequisites: Valduk has at least five Auras and/or Equipments attached to it.
2011-3920-4050.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Valduk triggers, creating at least five 3/1 Elemental creature tokens with trample and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Elementals, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
If Valduk has at least six Auras and/or Equipments attached to it and/or if Najeela attacks, this combo nets infinite creature tokens and colored mana.

553-1587.description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Failure by paying its mana cost, returning Approach of the Second Sun to your hand.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying its mana cost, causing you to win the game.

915-2364-4407.notablePrerequisites: Synod Artificer does not have summoning sickness.
915-2364-4407.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Synod Artificer's last ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Unbender Tine and Mana Vault.
Holding priority, activate Unbender Tine by tapping it, untapping Synod Artificer.
Repeat

132-578-2645.notablePrerequisites:
Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
132-578-2645.description:
Activate Myr Welder by tapping it, exiling Staff of Domination from your graveyard.
Activate Myr Welder using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Myr Welder.
Activate Myr Welder by tapping it, exiling Metalworker from your graveyard.
Activate Myr Welder using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Myr Welder.
Activate Myr Welder using Metalworker's ability by tapping it, revealing artifact cards from your hand, adding {C}{C} for each artifact cards revealed.
Repeat from step 4.
132-578-2645.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use any other ability from Staff of Domination in step 1 instead.

3478-3525-4644.notablePrerequisites:
Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Tidewater Minion.
3478-3525-4644.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Activate Tidewater Minion's last ability by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Repeat any number of times.
